record.field: You cannot delete the work order "%(order)s" because it is started or done.
The room "%(room)s" of the work order "%(order)s" does not belong to its hotel.
Select who is in charge of the work order "%(order)s" first.
The room "%(room)s" is occupied: the work order "%(order)s" cannot block it.
Select who claims the item "%(item)s" first.
You cannot delete the laundry batch "%(batch)s" because it is sent.
The laundry batch "%(batch)s" has no lines.
Set the laundry location of the hotel "%(hotel)s" first.
The returned quantity of "%(product)s" in the laundry batch "%(batch)s" must be between 0 and the sent quantity.
